name: Secrets of the Hopspital
source:
A fainting spell drops Periwinkle into another world – a rabbit clinic surrounded by darkness. Can you fight back the shadows and return home?

[From [url=https://starlight-eclipsecritter.itch.io/secrets-of-the-hopspital]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
昏厥的咒语让长春花进入了另一个世界——一个被黑暗包围的兔子诊所。你能击退阴影并回家吗？

[来自[url=https://starlight-eclipsecritter.itch.io/secrets-of-the-hopspital]Itch.io[/url]]
